state: MERGED into XC-01. Observation only

mechanism: Direct tunnelling across about 1 nm
state: MERGED into XC-05. Outside the range of a digital readout

mechanism: Transport through a few channels
state: CELL. Round 2: a map by material instead of a verdict. Metal 1 is bridged by its barrier (20 to 240 ohm per um, verified); a local-interconnect neck heats to roughly 500 to 1800 K with 4 to 8 mA (verified); low-bias reader holds 48 mV or less (verified)

mechanism: Coulomb blockade
state: CELL. Attack round 1: the arithmetic holds; it rides on XC-05, which is still open

mechanism: Dielectric breakdown
state: CELL. Round 4: out of reach at 3.3 V; plausible with the XC-53 pump; breakdown time unverifiable (7–14 decades), so the cell must sweep area and voltage. Waits for more than 1.8 V

mechanism: Emission from the XC-07 filament
state: MERGED into XC-07. Depends on XC-07

mechanism: Hot-carrier trapping
state: MERGED into XC-14. No SKY130 data

mechanism: BTI and HCI
state: INSTRUMENT (creates traps for XC-19 and, after attack round 1, for XC-52). No design

mechanism: Injection and tunnelling
state: MERGED into XC-14. Waits for a charge pump

mechanism: STI mechanical stress
state: INSTRUMENT (process metrology; Residual). Extraction gap confirmed; annotator applied to the whole standard-cell library; model prediction only

mechanism: Extra doping near the well edge
state: INSTRUMENT (process metrology). Not in the model card

mechanism: Plasma charge on a floating gate
state: CELL. Round 4, verified to order: on 4.15 nm oxide the plasma charge tunnels away (no fab-time memory); the residual drifts ~mV/day and tracks oxide thickness (clock / thickness gauge, conjecture). On 11.6 nm oxide it does not tunnel; survival through anneal unknown

mechanism: Plasma damage to gate oxide
state: MERGED into XC-14. Experiment defined

mechanism: Neighbours, orientation, density
state: INSTRUMENT (process metrology). Real diffusion lengths of every library cell now known (`experiments/stdcell_lod`)

mechanism: Parasitic capacitance
state: OUT (a parasitic capacitor: standard-cell territory). Low priority

mechanism: Parasitic channel under isolation
state: CELL. Threshold unknown

mechanism: Capture and emission at one defect
state: CELL. Reader simulated against four pre-registrations and drawn as a rule-clean channel; working point revised for shot noise; no trap demonstrated, no silicon

mechanism: Band-to-band tunnelling
state: CELL. Round 2: reverse tunnelling at zero separation is the firm observable (tens of nA to tens of uA at 1.8 V per 1.4 um, verified to the order of magnitude); negative resistance left open, it depends on a doping profile that is not public

mechanism: Reverse breakdown
state: CELL. Round 4: drawn-gap knob dead; drawn corner 6.6–9.7 V verified to order; with a pump 3–37 pA (one agent). Waits for high voltage

mechanism: Geiger-mode avalanche
state: MERGED into XC-21. Waits for high voltage

mechanism: Minority-carrier diffusion
state: INSTRUMENT (control of XC-26 (carriers before photons)). Stated only; also the control for XC-26

mechanism: Thyristor feedback
state: CELL. Latch-up risk

mechanism: Hall effect
state: CELL. Attack round 1: with the microcoil it is the most solid result of the round; Hall voltage 0.017 to 0.66 mV per mA depending on unknown well doping

mechanism: Radiative recombination in a forward junction
state: CELL. Round 4, verified to order: lives only with the emitter well at ~+1 V and substrate ≤10 Ω·cm (0.21–0.42 pA at 5 µm vs 0.15 pA floor); dies at ≥20 Ω·cm or cathode grounded

mechanism: Sub-wavelength apertures; diffraction at pitch near the wavelength
state: CELL. Round 4, verified to order: a cap changes only the escape cone, +1–4 %; needs ≥5 pA and <1 % matching. Reflection variant with the internal emitter of XC-26 entered 2026-11-12; depends on XC-26 emitting and on fill blocking; transmission still needs light on the die

mechanism: Guiding in the metal stack oxide
state: OUT (needs post-processing). Needs die access

state: OUT (never defined). Named only

state: INSTRUMENT (temperature knob and control). Unverified estimate

state: INSTRUMENT (supply control). The boring explanation every coupling experiment must rule out

mechanism: Bistable resolution
state: OUT (done with standard cells). The conventional baseline XC-19 must beat

mechanism: Delay cells as vernier, contention
state: INSTRUMENT (readout tooling). Tooling

state: MERGED into XC-19. Entered 2026-11-12; reuses the XC-19 reader; step size `[?]`; needs an array and temperature

mechanism: Band-to-band tunnelling under the gate edge
state: MERGED into XC-20. Entered 2026-11-12; expected weak at 1.8 V (unread source)

mechanism: Self-heating of a resistor with negative temperature coefficient
state: CELL. Entered 2026-11-12; coefficient read in the model card; oscillation judged unlikely, drift readable

mechanism: Seebeck effect between polysilicon and diffusion next to a heater
state: MERGED into XC-39. Entered 2026-11-12; the reader's own thermal drift exceeds one pair: needs a differential reference

mechanism: Charge that an oxide or MiM capacitor gives back after discharge
state: MERGED into XC-14. Entered 2026-11-12; signal expected near the reader step; MiM variant depends on the template

mechanism: Well potential set by leakage, threshold through body effect
state: MERGED into XC-14. Entered 2026-11-12; latch-up and precheck risk to be checked

mechanism: Interface traps filled and emptied by gate pulses
state: MERGED into XC-19. Entered 2026-11-12; f·q per trap is above the modelled floor at 1 MHz; needs body bias at mid-supply

mechanism: Piezoresistance of silicon under the mechanical stress of the package
state: INSTRUMENT (stress monitor). Entered 2026-11-12; only interpretable with an external bending control

mechanism: Direct tunnelling through the 1.8 V gate oxide discharging a floating gate
state: MERGED into XC-14. Entered 2026-11-12; time constant `[?]`; area sweep separates it from switch leakage

mechanism: Parasitic edge device and narrow-width threshold shift
state: INSTRUMENT (control of XC-12/13). Entered 2026-11-12; partly in the model card already: a control more than a cell

mechanism: Places where the open model is known to be wrong: bin edges, subthreshold hump
state: INSTRUMENT (model metrology; Residual). Entered 2026-11-12; upstream issue read; a job for Residual

mechanism: Depletion narrowing a well resistor
state: OUT (a junction transistor: conventional physics). Entered 2026-11-12; sheet resistance spread read in the PDK; bias dependence `[?]`

mechanism: Charge deposited by alpha or cosmic particles
state: OUT (event rate too low for one chip). Entered 2026-11-12; event rate estimated far too low for one chip (unread source)

mechanism: Light from hot carriers in a saturated transistor
state: MERGED into XC-26. Entered 2026-11-12; estimated below the reader floor (from memory, no source)

mechanism: Thermal rupture or migration in a polysilicon link
state: MERGED into XC-01. Entered 2026-11-12; published fuse used 10 mA at 3.3 V; whether SKY130 polysilicon is silicided `[?]`

mechanism: Recombination at interface traps changes with a millitesla field
state: CELL. Round 2: the four-state sequence does not remove classical even-in-field terms; discrimination rests on the shape against field. Coil verified at 0.373 mT per mA. No area assigned yet

mechanism: Dickson pump with the high-voltage devices of the PDK
state: INSTRUMENT (unlocks XC-07, 14, 18, 21). Round 4, verified: 8–10 V from 1.8 V with N=6–8, no device above 2.8 V, 15–18 % of a 1×2 tile; do not pump from 3.3 V (well exceeds 16.85 V breakdown); vertical PNP not yet modelled

mechanism: Titanium nitride may superconduct at a few kelvin
state: CELL. Entered 2026-11-12; costs no area (the lines exist); needs a cryostat; absorbs XC-30

mechanism: Metal gratings as acoustic mirrors around an unreleased resonator
state: CELL. Entered 2026-11-12; the most speculative entry; no calculation yet

mechanism: Millitesla field under a metal spiral
state: INSTRUMENT (field source for XC-25 and XC-52). Attack round 1, verified: 0.19 to 0.26 mT per mA; about 2 mT at the DC current limit of metal 3

mechanism: Heat pumped at a junction of two materials, reversing with the current
state: CELL. Round 3: the odd-in-current heat survives in the model (0.2 to 7 K at the junction at 100 uA); a reader in the silicon sees about 1 % of it, so readout takes seconds

mechanism: Thermal noise frozen on a small sampled capacitor
state: CELL. Round 3: survives as a randomness source and as a meter of 1 to 30 fF capacitances; primary thermometry not demonstrated (the observable goes as T^-1/2, verified), calibrated secondary sensitivity still to be assessed; doubles as the continuous-noise control for XC-19

mechanism: Defects made by stress and annealed by an on-chip heater
state: CELL. Round 3: dead for a transistor with an on-chip heater (the channel gets 1 to 16 % of the heater's rise, verified); alive for a polysilicon element on oxide, or with oven erase

mechanism: Carriers deflected by a field towards a surface where they recombine faster
state: CELL. Round 3: survives with another geometry (short diode, well-substrate junction as the active face); about 1 mT from a metal 1 strip (verified); cannot be claimed to beat a Hall plate

mechanism: Impact ionisation of frozen-out dopants in lightly doped silicon at low temperature
state: CELL. Round 3: transformed into a forward diode that fires pulses at 4.2 K; nothing at 77 K (well still 6 to 37 % ionised); needs a cryostat

mechanism: Lithographic rounding and pull-back changing the real gate where the drawing is legal
state: CELL. Round 3: legal and submittable; threshold moves 1.2 to 1.8 mV per nm of gate length (verified); would measure the residue of the fab's proximity correction

mechanism: Metal on lightly doped silicon forms a rectifying barrier instead of an ohmic contact
state: CELL. Round 3: the PDK itself ships seven cells with a contact on an unimplanted tap, all on p substrate (verified); on an n-well it passes only next to a normal tap; real interface unknown
